decisions.reason: An online customer portal is infrastructure for ordering and project handling that medium display manufacturers keep and improve once launched.
The packaging display solution won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, so it is a valuable showcase product the firm will keep promoting.
Quarter-pallet pegboard displays are a standard retail format with steady demand and have their own product page.
Small counter displays are a core, low-cost catalog item for point-of-sale display makers and fit the established business.
Large freestanding information displays round out the portfolio, though they are a somewhat more niche format, which leaves a slightly higher risk of being removed from the website.
